original_target.title: Exact capacity of the binary deletion channel

scope_comparison: The actual September2609.19412v1 Theorem2.1 gives an enclosure whose midpoint error is strictly below.0095, not exact capacity. New2609.13351 gives a high-deletion upper bound and2609.24908 lower bounds. The primary public code README expressly distinguishes midpoint estimate and achievable endpoint from exact capacity.
